Message:
“It won’t be long before you die.
That’s why...I shall kill you.”

Apparently, in a world
called Paradise, there exists
the ‘Curse of miracles,’
and it can grant any wish.”

“If I combine that power
with my own,
I can put your spirit into
someone else’s body.

You’ll be able to come back
to life, Great Hero!”

After hearing me speak,
the Hero cast his eyes down
in sorrow.

After a brief moment of silence,
he quietly nodded his head.

“I don’t have that much
longer anyway.
If I can save you
in my final moments,
I’ll die satisfied.”
